answer: web-of-trust with distance-weighted endorsement is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. Cloning 779 keys multiplies the price 779-fold: 83353 POA locked, or 13243 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. One onyx of signal, one signal of cost, one ember of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
